## BayWaT-AI <span class="badge-soon">starting Oct 2026</span>

::: {.highlight-box}
**River water temperatures and riverine heatwaves in Bavaria.** Deep-learning models to predict stream water temperatures and detect riverine heatwave events under climate change, building on hydrological and meteorological data across Bavarian catchments.
:::

## ClimEx II

*2022 – 2025*

One of my largest projects to date. Using single-model large ensembles (SMILEs) to decompose climate model output into forced signal, bias and internal variability, with application to drought. Contributions include a multivariate bias correction method based on zero-inflated vine copulas ([VBC](https://github.com/henrifnk/VBC)), a generalised-additive-model framework for quantifying the spatio-temporal structure of internal variability, its application to a standardised drought index revealing a near-certain southeastern European drought hotspot under +3°C warming, and a deep-learning drought forecasting framework that propagates ensemble-derived uncertainty into probabilistic forecasts. See the [publication](publications.qmd) on vine copula bias correction.
